prompts.walk: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production animation sprite sheet with ACTUAL transparent alpha background for an existing top-down Phaser 3 game. Input Image 1 is the identity and art-style reference, not a layout to preserve. Extend this exact sturdy middle-aged Chinese plumber into a WALK CYCLE animation sheet. Keep the same short messy black hair, light stubble, mustard ochre work vest, short rolled cream sleeves, dark petrol work trousers, brown boots, coiled tan rope and red rubber plunger held close to his waist. Match the reference hand-painted crisp ink-outline game art and warm palette, consistent proportions, strictly elevated top-down 3/4 camera. Layout absolutely exact: PORTRAIT 3:4 image, 1536x2048 if possible, a regular grid of 6 equal columns and 8 equal rows, 48 separate frames, each cell square. Nothing drawn between cells. Row direction order from top to bottom: row 1 EAST (screen right, right profile), row 2 SOUTHEAST (down-right, face visible), row 3 SOUTH (screen down, front view), row 4 SOUTHWEST (down-left, face visible), row 5 WEST (screen left, left profile), row 6 NORTHWEST (up-left, back visible), row 7 NORTH (screen up, back of head and vest), row 8 NORTHEAST (up-right, back visible). For EACH row six consecutive distinct walk-cycle phases left-to-right: left foot forward contact, left passing, feet neutral/down, right foot forward contact, right passing, feet neutral/up. Clear alternating leg stride and opposite arm swing, slight shoulders/hip twist. Character stays the same size, centered on the identical body pivot in every square, full body occupies about 72% of cell height with generous transparent margins. Feet ground anchor consistent. Keep weapon tucked in, not blocking feet. No ground shadows, no backdrop, no typography, no numbers, no row labels, no borders, no gridlines, no arrows. Must be 48 isolated drawings and a truly transparent background, no baked checkerboard. These are individual frames to be sliced and played sequentially, not a poster.
prompts.attack: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production four-frame eight-direction ATTACK sprite sheet with ACTUAL transparent alpha background for an existing top-down action game. Input Image 1 is the exact character identity and art-style reference. Make new animation poses of this same sturdy middle-aged Chinese plumber: messy short black hair, stubble, ochre mustard work vest over rolled-sleeve cream shirt, dark petrol trousers, brown boots, tan coiled rope and red rubber plunger. Strict elevated top-down 3/4 camera, hand-painted crisp ink outlines, warm desaturated colors, consistent body scale and identity. Layout absolutely exact: PORTRAIT 1:2 image, ideally1024x2048, exactly 4 equal columns and 8 equal rows, 32 isolated square cells. Direction order rows top-bottom: EAST screen right / SOUTHEAST down-right / SOUTH screen down front / SOUTHWEST down-left / WEST screen left / NORTHWEST up-left back / NORTH screen up back / NORTHEAST up-right back. Every row contains four clearly distinct consecutive THROW ATTACK poses left-right: 1 wind-up with plunger pulled back and shoulder turned, 2 forceful forward release with throwing arm fully extended toward that row's direction, 3 follow-through with hand open and rope hand braced at belt, 4 recovery with body returning toward neutral and empty throwing hand. The cup and handle belong to the held weapon only in frame 1; in frame 2 weapon is just leaving the hand, tiny near hand; frames 3 and 4 throwing hand is empty because the actual projectile is separately rendered in game. Other hand controls rope coil throughout. Body remains planted on consistent foot anchor, centered at exact same body pivot, about 65% cell height so extended arms fit, leave generous transparent margin. Do not change clothes or face between frames. No detached airborne projectiles beyond the figure, no long trailing rope out of cell, no scenery, no cast shadows, no motion blur, no effects, no text, no numbers, no borders, no gridlines, no baked checkerboard. Exactly32 drawings on transparent alpha.
prompts.projectiles: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent production projectile animation sprite sheet for a hand-painted top-down 2D action game. ACTUAL transparent alpha background, no checkerboard baked in. Landscape 2:1 sheet ideally1536x768, exactly6 equal columns and3 equal rows, 18 isolated square frames. Row1: six sequential flight animation phases of one red rubber toilet PLUNGER on a short warm wooden handle, viewed from above at a slight 3/4 angle, horizontal flight to screen RIGHT. The rubber CUP is on the RIGHT end facing right, wooden handle extends left, no rope attached in the art (rope is separately rendered). Each phase slightly varies axial tumble/foreshortening, cup squash and highlight, but weapon maintains rightward orientation and remains identifiable. Cup coral red, dark maroon rim, ochre wood, crisp dark ink outlines, about70% cell width, readable at36px. Row2: six sequential pulsing jade/mint organic ENERGY ORBS for allied ranged shots, luminous seedlike center and short curved green wisps rotating around it, tight silhouette, mint cream core, transparent fading edge, no long trail. Row3: six sequential pulsing coral/orange organic ENERGY ORBS for enemy ranged shots, bright cream core, coral ember shell and tiny moving flame fins, dark terracotta contour, no long trail. Six phases should produce a continuous seamless loop per row with clear visible shape change. Each projectile centered precisely in its square with identical pivot; margin of20% prevents bleeding. Same hand-painted bold ink indie art as a Chinese dusk city game. No other objects, no floor, no shadows, no typography, no labels, no borders, no gridlines.
